Author: Real Nunu
Name: Nunu's Windbound Bard
Punchline: MIDI Editor, Bard Workbench, native ensembles, and concert capture.
Description: Windbound Bard MIDI suite with a piano roll, MIDI Workbench, native ensembles and MP4 concert capture. Hosted Band adds join-code sessions with Concert Director, remote instrument and ARM controls, and scheduled playback. Includes copyable relay diagnostics, Concert Director, opt-in party follow, and Shortcut Bars. Hosted STARTs require all performers to confirm they are armed; failed or missing confirmations cancel the downbeat for the whole band.
Changelog: Capture Studio FFmpeg compatibility: remove input-side thread_queue_size (caused encoder exit -22 on newer FFmpeg); rebuild and bundle the updated native Capture Engine rather than reusing the old executable. Includes v0.46.5 all-Bard START fixes.
